cadence: Three core product posts daily, including weekends, plus a fourth useful question, result, or product improvement. Saturday includes an aspirational question supplied by Facundo.

posts.title: Your buyer stays ahead.
posts.x:
Your buyer stays ahead.

BUY HARD watches stock and prepares reorders before you run out. OpenAI helps research and prepare the buy.

Sample workflow: https://buyhard.app/?demo=true&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buyhard_allgas_202609&utm_content=p2_openai

@convex @OpenAI @firecrawl @agentmail
posts.linkedin:
“Cups are low. Reorder ready.”

That's the kind of update your buyer should bring to you.

BUY HARD uses your stock counts, usage, buying rules, and incoming deliveries to work out when a recurring item needs replenishing. With replenishment enabled, it starts preparing the buy without waiting for you to open a chat and ask.

OpenAI helps the buyer research options and prepare the purchase. You review the terms and approve spending.

A one-off stock correction is there when something changes. Routine buying is the main job.

Explore the sample workflow:
https://buyhard.app/?demo=true&utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buyhard_allgas_202609&utm_content=p2_openai

Built with Convex, OpenAI, Firecrawl, and AgentMail for the Convex All Gas Hackathon.

The visual illustrates the workflow; the public demo uses sample data.
posts.alt: BUY HARD: Your buyer stays ahead. Beside a stack of cups, the buyer says: Cups are low. Reorder ready. Stock watched. Reorders prepared. Powered by OpenAI. Workflow illustration. buyhard.app. All four sponsors credited.

Start with a link. Automated buying.

Firecrawl reads the product page. BUY HARD prepares the purchase and orders after your approval.

Illustrated workflow. Book a walkthrough: https://buyhard.app/walkthrough?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buyhard_allgas_202609&utm_content=p3_firecrawl

@convex @OpenAI @firecrawl @agentmail
posts.linkedin:
Start with a link. Let your buyer handle the buying work.

A familiar product page can become part of your recurring purchasing setup.

Firecrawl reads product details. BUY HARD researches the offer, prepares the purchase, and carries out the supported order after you approve its terms. The buyer then reports the result.

The card illustrates that outcome: “I purchased 20 cases of paper cups from WebstaurantStore.” It's an example, not a completed merchant order or a claim of verified support for that store.

Bring one supplier link to a 20-minute walkthrough:
https://buyhard.app/walkthrough?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=buyhard_allgas_202609&utm_content=p3_firecrawl
